summary: Netanyahu announced direct involvement in the judicial-overhaul process despite the conflict-of-interest restriction; on March 24 the attorney general told him the involvement violated the binding arrangement and was unlawful.
notes: Canonical Sheet written first. Exact Kan News video of the March 23 statement recovered. Preserve the limiting legal outcome: the attorney general later said contempt sanctions were not warranted and the High Court rejected the contempt petition on May 1 while maintaining that attorney-general conflict opinions bind the prime minister unless a court rules otherwise. No motive is inferred and this is not a criminal conviction or finding that the overhaul was undertaken for personal benefit. Stable GitHub preview uses the thumbnail belonging to the exact Kan video, not a generic leader image.
